data.name: Above Land: Rhapsody
data.detailed_description:
Grab a Toy. Save the Leviathans.

Your mission is to save the mythical leviathans, known as Kuns, from monster infestations. Your weapons are your toys! Equip your favorite toy, team up with friends, and fight together across danger-filled terrains on the back of gigantic leviathans. Defeat the monsters, extract precious loot, craft new toys, then head out to save more Kuns!

Weapons That Shouldn't Work But Do

Smack the enemies with a basketball, a folding chair, a yo-yo, a megaphone and every childhood fantasy you ever dreamed of. Each toy weapon comes with its own moveset and combat mechanics, and somehow works rather nicely (and deadly) in a fight.

Every Run Is Unique...with a Twist!

Yes, with over 1,000 perks, your every run will be unique. But be warned, you may be challenged to step out of your comfort zone every so often...like, shouting "Mama" into the microphone to land a crit!

Between Missions: the Invincible Bebe

After each run, return to the Invincible Bebe — a stranded spaceship where you appear in your true child form. It turns out all your adventures took place in your favourite comic book. To reach the next chapters, you must use the loot you bring back to upgrade and repair the ship. You can also unlock new crew members onboard who can help you craft new toys, outfits and items.

Co-Op Makes Chaos Better

Team up with 1 or 2 friends, and face the chaos together.

Coordinate builds, revive teammates, combine weapons and perks into unexpected team-wide setups, and kick butt!

Meet Wobbo, Your Battle Companion

Wobbo, the one-of-a-kind baby Kun who will grow up to be the one Kun to rule them all, has picked you as its person. The bond between you and Wobbo is the only hope of thwarting the apocalypse. Not only is Wobbo central to the narrative, it fights beside you. Equip different relics to make it attack autonomously, summon allies, or even transform YOU into a monster.

And yes, you can dress Wobbo.

Wondrous World Above the Clouds

Each level sits on the back of a leviathan, dead, alive or mechanical. Soar across the sky to discover ancient ruins, strange civilizations, and deep secrets hidden in the clouds.

English*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*, Traditional Chinese*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: HDD supported, SSD recommended for better experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 or AMD Ryzen 5 5500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060, AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT 6GB, or Intel Arc A750 6GB
  • Storage: 80 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
  • Additional Notes: HDD supported, SSD recommended for better experience.
